description: Mission 1 gameplay sounds of the N64 port. Each entry is an original 68000 sound request word (ROM 0120F8) with the callers that issued it in MAME gameplay captures (tools/extract_sound_map.py) and the latch bytes that render it in isolation (tools/render_sound_commands.py). Numbers only; the audio is rendered locally from the user's ROM.
